title: Track the round-1 proof files: un-ignore evals/results/ and commit them
description: opum-doc ruling A (note on ODOC-497; ODOC-497 operator-approved, opum-doc#1133), from finding 1 of PSKI-9: evals/results/ is gitignored and has never been committed, yet CLAUDE.md, README.md and the docs cite evals/results/round1-proofs/ as the proofs. The round-1 proof files exist on disk (8 files, 76K: round1-proofs/ and round1-v2-summary.json), so un-ignore evals/results/, commit them, and keep the citations. archive-scrub over the directory exited 0 (clean: no credential shapes in 8 files) before any copy. Never cite evidence the repository does not hold.
finalSummary: PSKI-20 done under ODOC-497 (opum-doc ruling A).
